applyAfter: All review-manifest.json overlays in their listed order; append format_corrections_3.json.
method: Exhaustive scan of every English main meaning, literal/figurative explanation, part gloss, example translation and chunk gloss in this partition after the entire frozen overlay stack. All 75 affected strings were read before and after in lexical or example context. Explicit exact-string edits preserve meaning and references using already reviewed tone-marked pinyin or clear English; no general dictionary-sense guessing and no validator relaxation.

sources.support: Capacity-unit sense is gě, distinct from hé; retains the half-unit relationship.
Compound reference guā lóu for Chinese cucumber.
Compound reference ér miáo for emu.
Compound reference xiǎn yǔn for the ancient people Xianyun.
